_comment: Where the three repos live. 'local' is the owner's Windows machine; in a cloud session clone 'github' into a scratch dir and ignore 'local'. Scripts read resourceslist.local (override with RL_REPO or --repo).

automation.role: control plane: playbooks, templates, skills, per-video run logs

resourceslist.role: the directory site (Astro + Cloudflare Workers); one markdown file per resource

videoediting.role: HyperFrames video workspace; one video = one folder under videos/
